messages.subject: Caldera / Project Cedar — completion bring-down
messages.plaintextBody:
James — separate matter, not Ferncliffe: on the Halstead/Caldera CM-7 manufacturing agreement (Project Cedar) we need the bring-down certificate and the updated signature pack before Friday's completion. Can you ask Elena where the executed counterparts have got to? Keep this off the litigation file. Thanks, Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0012
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
